item.description:
### Added - **Software Updates** — link to the full release notes on GitHub from the update dialog, the pending-update card in Settings, and the About Toolbox section, so you can see what's new even when you're up to date
### Changed - **Window Snapper** — pressing an active Workspace Profile again restores the previous workspace from every activation path — keyboard shortcut, Apply button, and status bar menu — with a **Restore** affordance (button label + status bar pill) when a restore is available
